purpose: Prospective native full-trajectory development check after interface repair, not independent phenomenon confirmation or method validation
selection: All reviewed availability-by-relative-price cells; do not select cells based on historical model success
tool_schedule: Three symmetric opportunities, followed by answer-or-abstain terminal opportunity
pricing_basis: Peak cache-miss input 2 CNY/million and output 8 CNY/million; no cache-hit or off-peak discount assumed
capacity_qualification: Fee bound conditional on admitted reference counts matching provider usage and fixed output caps. This is not proof every possible four-turn history fits 8192 or finishes before deadline. Reject oversized context without truncation, preserve failed/not-started cells.
intended_readout: Protocol coverage, invalid output, cache access, executed SQL, answer or abstention per fixed cell
Client-accounted token cost and declared tool cost kept separate
Final-answer task fidelity requires semantic assessment; do not infer C-type drift from cache access or wrong answer alone
comparison_limit: Earlier text and native first-response batches are development history, not a randomized contemporaneous interface-effect comparison
next_gate: Finish frozen launcher, shared-accounting and outer-archive audit, then request fresh batch approval and hidden local credential entry
